name: Receiving
_about: Fields added by the HomeCartel spec v1.4 (02 Procurement / 05 Receiving, 05 Shared Engines 01, 04): the four receiving events (arrived, counted, binned, available) as server stamps, the queue columns of the Arrivals list, and the shortage suggestion. Written by the server (server/modules/procurement/receiving-spec.mjs).

fields.name: Order_Date
fields.label: Order Date
fields.helpText: Oldest Sales Order date among the lines (DT-1).

fields.name: Arrived_At
fields.label: Arrived
fields.helpText: The gate log, or derived: before the first count (T-5).

fields.name: Binned_At
fields.label: Binned
fields.helpText: When every line has a bin location.

fields.name: Available_At
fields.label: Available
fields.helpText: When every line is counted in full and binned: pickable.

fields.name: Line_Stamps
fields.label: Line Stamps
fields.helpText: JSON: counted / binned / available time of each line (the first time, never overwritten).

fields.name: Report_Arrived_On
fields.label: Arrived on (gate log)
fields.helpText: Write-only: yyyy-MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm. The server stamps Arrived with when it happened and when we were told.
